gold.question: A seller claims that a standard term in a consumer contract covered by Directive 93/13/EEC was individually negotiated. Who must prove that claim?
gold.reference_answer: The seller or supplier who makes that claim bears the burden of proof.
key_facts: Where any seller or supplier claims that a standard term has been individually negotiated, the burden of proof in this respect shall be incumbent on him.
